value.Title: 051140 Furnishings, loose carpets, rugs
value.Description:
051140 Furnishings, loose carpets and rugs (D)

Includes:
- loose carpets and rugs
- pictures, sculptures, engravings, tapestries and other art objects, including reproductions of works of art and other ornaments
- statuettes and other decorative articles, including those made of porcelain and crystal glass
- wall clocks, floor clocks, alarm clocks and travel clocks
- screens, folding partitions, non-textile blinds, mirrors, candle holders and candlesticks
- leather and fur for upholstery and room decoration

Excludes:
- fitted carpets and linoleum (043110)
- repair and hire of loose carpets and other furniture and furnishings (051200)
- installation of furniture and furnishings if separately priced from delivery (051200)
- bedding (bed linen) (052120)
- sunshades (052190)   
- safes (053190)
- ornamental glass and ceramic articles (054010)
- delivery of loose carpets and other furniture and furnishings if separately priced (074920)
- installation of furniture and furnishings if not separately priced from delivery (074920)
- carrycots, pushchairs and strollers; and wall thermometers and barometers (132910)
- works of art acquired primarily as stores of value (capital formation)

value.Title: 093200 Pets and pet products
value.Description:
093200 Pets and pet products (D)

Includes:
- pets, pet foods, pet veterinary and grooming products, collars, leashes, kennels, birdcages, fish tanks, cat litter

Also includes:
- feed and veterinary products for animals used for transportation, own consumption or recreation

Excludes:
- horses, ponies, camels and dromedaries used for transport (071400)
- horses, ponies, camels and dromedaries used for recreation (091240)
- veterinary and other services for pets and other household animals (094500)

value.Title: 093220 Products for pets, etc.
value.Description:
093220 Products for pets and other household animals (ND)

Includes:
- pet foods, pet veterinary and grooming products, collars, leashes, kennels, birdcages, fish tanks, cat litter

Also includes:
- feed and veterinary products for animals used for transportation, own consumption or recreation

Excludes:
- veterinary and other services for pets and other household animals (094500)

value.Title: 094500 Veterinary services, etc.
value.Description:
094500 Veterinary and other services for pets (S)

Includes:
- veterinary and other pet services, such as grooming, tattooing and training
- pet boarding services and pet day-care services.

Also includes:
- veterinary and hosting services for household animals, such as animals used for transportation, own consumption or recreation

Excludes:
- pet products (093220)
